summary.text: Patrick Ahrens represents California's 26th Assembly District in Santa Clara County, which includes Cupertino, Santa Clara, Sunnyvale and part of San José.

paragraphs.text: Before joining the Assembly, he served as a Trustee on the Foothill-De Anza Community College District Board.

Ahrens, a native of Silicon Valley, earned an associate degree from De Anza College, a bachelor's degree from UCLA and a master's degree in public administration from San José State University, and lives in Sunnyvale.
